description: Use when writing, converting, or testing Sigma detection rules for a defensive detection program. Covers Sigma rule structure, logsource taxonomy, detection selection syntax, modifiers, conditions, testing with the Sigma CLI, and converting one rule to Splunk SPL, Elastic, and other backends. Use when the team needs vendor-neutral detections that run on more than one SIEM, or when contributing rules to a shared detection repo.
